# HAPI v0.25.3.1

Compared with the previous maintained release, [`v0.25.1.3`](https://github.com/swear01/hapi/releases/tag/v0.25.1.3), this rebuild advances the base to official v0.25.3, retains the maintained fleet, session import, media, steering, and release workflow, and repairs the baseline verification dependencies.

Compared with the official release, [`v0.25.3`](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/releases/tag/v0.25.3), it adds the reviewed heads of upstream PRs #1315 through #1325: running-session grouping, VAPID re-subscription, voice-backend gating, custom Claude models, an expandable composer, Antigravity PTY support, query-stable autocomplete, attachment previews and failure recovery, queued-edit recovery, and rich-composer DOM/Unicode boundary fixes.

Maintained-fork guarantees: the release commit is contained in `swear01/hapi` `main`, uses a four-part maintenance tag, publishes checksums and signed macOS artifacts, and is rolled out with session-preserving fleet checks.
